author: Aksara editors
title: The River Remembers
khmer: ទន្លេចងចាំ
description: What the water carries, and what it leaves with us.
lines: The river does not ask our names.
It knows us by the way we wait,
barefoot at the edge of evening,
holding a little of the light.
My mother called across the water.
The water carried back the sky.
All these years, I have been listening
for the shore inside her voice.
khmerLines: ទន្លេហូរកាត់ភូមិខ្ញុំ
នាំយកពន្លឺពេលល្ងាច។
ខ្ញុំឈរនៅមាត់ទឹក
នឹកសំឡេងម្តាយហៅពីផ្ទះ។
ទឹកហូរទៅឆ្ងាយ
តែការចងចាំនៅទីនេះ។

author: Aksara editors
title: A Small Place to Return
khmer: កន្លែងតូចមួយសម្រាប់ត្រឡប់
description: A doorway, an old tree, the familiar shape of belonging.
lines: Leave the gate a little open.
Let the morning find its way
past the mango tree, past the shoes
we outgrew but never threw away.
A home is not the walls we build.
It is the space someone keeps
beside them, when the rain begins.
khmerLines: ទុកទ្វារឱ្យនៅចំហ
ឱ្យពន្លឺព្រឹកចូលមក។
នៅក្រោមដើមស្វាយចាស់
មានស្រមោលនៃកុមារភាព។
ផ្ទះនៅតែរង់ចាំ
ថ្ងៃដែលយើងត្រឡប់មក។

author: Aksara editors
title: After the First Rain
khmer: ក្រោយភ្លៀងដំបូង
description: The world begins again in the scent of wet earth.
lines: The first rain finds every leaf.
Even the dust remembers green.
Under the eaves, we say nothing.
There is so much to hear:
the tin roof, the waking field,
the earth opening its hands.
khmerLines: ភ្លៀងដំបូងធ្លាក់លើស្លឹកឈើ
ក្លិនដីថ្មីហើរតាមខ្យល់។
យើងអង្គុយស្ងៀមក្រោមដំបូល
ស្តាប់សំឡេងពិភពលោក។
វាលស្រែភ្ញាក់ឡើងវិញ
ក្រោមមេឃស្រឡះ។

author: Aksara editors
title: Between Two Languages
khmer: រវាងភាសាពីរ
description: On finding a voice between the words we inherit.
lines: One word lives in my mouth.
Another lives in my hands.
When I speak of home,
both turn toward the same window.
I am learning to leave it open.
khmerLines: ពាក្យមួយនៅក្នុងចិត្ត
ពាក្យមួយទៀតនៅលើក្រដាស។
ពេលខ្ញុំនឹកដល់ផ្ទះ
ភាសាទាំងពីរស្ងៀមស្ងាត់។
ខ្ញុំបើកបង្អួច
ឱ្យខ្យល់ចូលមក។

author: Aksara editors
title: The Things We Keep
khmer: អ្វីដែលយើងរក្សាទុក
lines: A folded letter. A cup with a crack.
The photograph that will not fade.
We make a little room for yesterday
and call it a drawer.
Sometimes I open it
just to let the light in.
khmerLines: សំបុត្រចាស់មួយ
រូបថតនៅក្នុងថតតុ។
ខ្ញុំបើកវាមើល
នៅពេលពន្លឺរសៀលចូលមក។
អ្វីដែលយើងរក្សាទុក
ក៏រក្សាយើងដែរ។

author: Aksara editors
title: Where the Palms Stand
khmer: កន្លែងដែលដើមត្នោតឈរ
description: A landscape that stays with you long after you leave.
lines: Beyond the last house, the palms stand
like notes on an unwritten page.
The field is quiet. The sky is wide.
A bicycle becomes a speck of light.
Nothing asks to be remembered.
I remember everything.
khmerLines: ដើមត្នោតឈរនៅចុងភូមិ
ក្រោមមេឃពណ៌មាស។
ផ្លូវតូចនាំទៅវាលស្រែ
ខ្យល់បក់កាត់ស្មៅខ្ចី។
ខ្ញុំដើរទៅយឺតៗ
ចងចាំពន្លឺនៅទីនេះ។
